source_bindings.note: Repository draft is not the installed approved manifest and must not replace it.

preflight: Bind the published source/checkpoint commit and revalidate this operation index before any host read or mutation.
Read exact installed hashes for launcher, recorder, unchanged runtime and installed APPROVED_FOR_START manifest; drift stops the operation.
Read the current shortcut and Host task, including action, arguments, WorkingDirectory, principal, triggers, enabled/state and last result.
Freshly observe the exact Windows client and reject foreign or multiple client processes.
Confirm all six pinned containers, PostgreSQL healthy, one Public and one Private Gateway, Supervisor INTENTIONALLY_STOPPED, required HTTP and public control 404.
Confirm no backup, import, maintenance, prior Host attempt or competing operation is running. Docker/WSL pool and swap remain explicit UNKNOWN, not PASS.

mutation.preimages: Capture and hash only the two changed installed targets before writes.

manual_entry_branch.one_exact_client_already_running: Treat it only as observed preexisting state; invoke one new repeat entry, require exactly one client, zero service/container starts and one complete new recorder attempt.
manual_entry_branch.exact_client_not_running: Invoke one new manual entry and require one complete recorder attempt, then invoke one repeat in the same operation; the historical unsettled attempt is not run one.
manual_entry_branch.common_acceptance: Require BASE_READY_LIMITED_CAPTURED, complete untruncated stdout, empty stderr, launcher exit 0, consistent NEXT_STABIL_STARTUP_RESULT_V1, base readiness and no duplicate stack or client.

reboot_gate: After manual entry/repeat, obtain current owner confirmation that no backup, import or material work is active.
Confirm local access or RustDesk unattended/start-with-Windows recovery and persist the resume point under output_root.
Perform exactly one Windows restart only after that confirmation.
post_reboot: Continue the same operation and do not manually start NEXT Stabil before cold/logon evaluation.
Verify the real Host logon trigger, pinned set readiness, exactly one client after base readiness, no duplicates, public control 404 and Supervisor INTENTIONALLY_STOPPED.
Obtain owner confirmation that the CRM/Web client list and one client detail open correctly.
failure_contract: No second reboot and no blind retry.
Use only a preprepared rollback limited to the two operation-owned file preimages when ownership and safe state are proven.
Do not restore the Startup wrapper and do not restore data.
forbidden: new containers, image or mount changes
junction, data, migration, backup, restore, relocation, retention, purge or cleanup changes
